subject: POC plan & final readout for Aurelia Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@aureliahealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Goal: Run a 3-week POC to validate latency/cost for your clinical summarization pipeline and confirm no PHI egress in hosted flows.
- Success criteria (draft): average tail latency < 350ms @ 99th percentile for 1k reqs/day, token cost < $0.002/token, throughput 10 req/s sustained, and acceptable answer quality on the provided eval set (F1 >= 0.78 for entity extraction).
- Owners: Redwood (Marissa / Marcus) to provide onboarding checklist, deployment guide, and baseline prompts. Aurelia (Tom) to provide eval dataset, access to a staging dataset, and security contacts (Karen) for the compliance questionnaire.
- Timeline (proposed):
  * Week 0 (this week): contract/PO check, security intake, and data access provisioning.
  * Week 1: baseline run and tuning (quantization/profile).
  * Week 2: focused eval and regressions.
  * Week 3: final readout and exec decision.

I attached a short POC proposal and a success criteria spreadsheet — please review and flag anything missing. Can we aim to schedule the final readout the week of Aug 24? If that works, I'll send calendar invites and a readout template.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf, POC-success-criteria.xlsx
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@aureliahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aureliahealth.com>, Karen Liu <karen.liu@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks Marissa — this is very helpful.

A few quick notes: 
- The success criteria look reasonable overall. I'll confirm the evaluation metrics with our data science lead, but the F1 target is a good starting point.
- I'll loop in procurement / legal (Karen) for the contract and security intake. Karen — can you confirm what evidence you need for SOC2 and the data flow diagram?
- Timeline is tight but doable. We aim to have the staging dataset ready by Friday (Aug 14).

If we can lock in the final readout for Aug 25, that gives our execs time to review post-readout and make a go/no-go decision by the end of that week.

Sarah
Director of Clinical Informatics | Aurelia Health
sarah.kim@aureliahealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@aureliahealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Sarah — perfect, thanks. A few concrete items from our side to make week 0 smooth: 

1) Security intake: Marcus will send the SOC2 summary and a short data flow diagram. Marcus — I'll need the one-pager by EOD tomorrow so I can pass it to Karen.
2) Data access: Tom, please share an S3 read-only path or a secure link to the staging dataset. If you prefer, we can set up a short SCP transfer; otherwise a signed S3 presigned URL is fine.
3) Baseline prompts & eval harness: Attached the readout template and eval harness instructions. We'll run a blind eval against your test set and share the scoring script.

Proposed final readout schedule: Aug 25, 10:00–10:45 PT — 30–45 min (30 min demo, 10–15 min Q&A). I'll include a short exec summary for the leadership attendees. If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives and I'll coordinate.

Linking the hubspot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
DocuSign (contract placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/abcdefg

Thanks all — attaching the updated POC proposal with owners/timeline filled out.

Best,
Marissa

Sounds good — confirmed on our side.

We can provide the staging S3 bucket (read-only) by EOD Friday; Karen will follow up separately on compliance evidence.

Aug 25 10:00 PT works for the final readout. I'll invite our VP of Engineering and our Head of Data to the readout; Sarah will invite the clinical execs. Please include a short slide showing cost implications and the recommended next contract step (term + expected monthly consumption).

Thanks — see you on the 25th.

Tom
Senior Engineering Manager | Aurelia Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aureliahealth.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final readout invite & exec decision steps (Aug 25)

Tom / Sarah —

Thanks for confirming. Calendar invite sent for Aug 25, 10:00–10:45 PT (Zoom link included). Below is the readout agenda and decision steps so execs have clarity: 

Agenda (30–45 min):
- 0–5m: Intro & success criteria recap (Marissa)
- 5–20m: Demo of POC runs and key metrics (Marcus)
- 20–30m: Quality & regression analysis (Marcus + Sarah)
- 30–40m: Cost run-rate and performance tradeoffs (Marissa)
- 40–45m: Recommendation & next steps (Marissa)

Decision path: 
- Go: sign the two-way SOW + reserved capacity commitment (option A) or start with monthly consumption (option B). We'll have a contract placeholder in DocuSign; procurement (Karen) can route PO or e-signature.
- No-go: we capture lessons learned, log regressions, and propose a follow-up POC on the two held-out cases.

Pre-reads: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf and POC-success-criteria.xlsx (attached).
DocuSign link (contract placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/abcdefg
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If anyone needs the readout moved, please reply-all within 24 hours. Looking forward to a productive session.

Best,
Marissa Cole
